The '''New Territories''' was a region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] north of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] and the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="TEA" />

The [[D'Asta family]] was the most influential family of the New Territories.<ref name="TEA" />
==History==
It largely had been undeveloped for millennia aside from the well-known planets of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. Promotion of expansion in this region failed miserably on numerous occasions, but misfortunes such as he atrocities of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]] ([[3970 BBY]]-[[3670 BBY]]) and later the disastrous [[Outer Expansion Zone/Legends|Outer Expansion Zone]] initiative ([[700 BBY]]) paralyzed the development. 

Finally in the later years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the settlement accelerated with the dispatching of a large fleet owned by the [[D'Asta family|D'Asta]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] from [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], who created various markets along the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]]. Meanwhile, [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Nalroni Merchant Council|merchants]] worked to establish markets beyond the [[Celanon Spur/Legends|Celanon Spur]]. With these successes, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] dubbed it the "New Territories" and invested heavily in the region, thanks to the [[Planetary Pioneers]]; it remained fiercely loyal to the Republic and then the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] as a result.<ref name="TEA" />

Nevertheless, Empire successor states were established in this region, such as the [[Pentastar Alignment]], the [[Ciutric Hegemony]] and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], however, the region was devastated and struggled to recover.<ref name="TEA" />
